title: BARRAGE x
features:
Auto Tower — automatically starts towers with optional Auto Equip Best

Auto Collect Money — collects money from all card display pages with page flipping support

Auto Buy Packs — watches the conveyor for packs matching your selected names and mutations, checks you can afford it before buying, with max price filter

Auto Place Packs — equips and places packs on free spots across your plot with Walk/Tween/Teleport movement and live status display

Auto Open Packs — detects "Ready!" packs and opens them via ProximityPrompt with Walk/Tween/Teleport movement

Auto Collect Drops — collects Luck, HatchTime, TravelTokens, Mutation, XP, PetLuck drops

Auto Potions — automatically uses all potion tiers (Luck, HatchTime, Mutation, XP, PetLuck 1-3)

Conveyor Status — live auto-refreshing display of packs on your conveyor with name, mutation, and price

Player Info — live display of cash balance, plot number, max price, and selected filters

Player Modifications — custom Walk Speed and Jump Power sliders

Anti AFK — prevents idle kick

Config Save/Load — all settings persist to file
